findings: [major] vulnerability — billing/reconcile.py:1: PARTNER_API_KEY = "sk-live-..." live credential committed to source; anyone with repo/history read access can call the partner balance API. Fix: load from env/secret manager and rotate the key.

[major] edge-case — billing/reconcile.py:7: `for i in range(1, len(rows))` skips rows[0]. reconcile_ledger_rows([Row(5.0)], 5.0) -> False; [Row(999.0), Row(10.0)] vs 10.0 -> True. Correct ledgers rejected, first-row discrepancies hidden. Fix: range(len(rows)) or sum(r.amount for r in rows).

[major] missing-validation — billing/reconcile.py:14: partner_id interpolated into URL unencoded; "../admin/keys" or "42?include=all#" reaches other paths with the live bearer token. Fix: validate type/charset and urllib.parse.quote(str(partner_id), safe="").

[major] missing tests — billing/test_reconcile.py: new public function fetch_partner_balance has no tests. Locking assertion: stubbed http_client.get returning {"balance": 42} -> returns 42 and was called with exact URL https://billing.internal.example/partners/7/balance; partner_id="a/b" raises or is encoded as a%2Fb.

[minor] error-handling — billing/reconcile.py:13-18: no raise_for_status, no timeout on http_client.get (stalled upstream hangs reconcile), response.json()["balance"] raises KeyError/decode error on error bodies and returns None on null balance.

[minor] undefined symbol — billing/reconcile.py:13: http_client is neither imported nor defined in the shown hunk (top of file); first call raises NameError unless defined elsewhere. Unverifiable — file does not exist in workspace.

[minor] test cannot execute — billing/test_reconcile.py:9-11: module imports only reconcile_ledger_rows; `Row` is undefined, so the new test (and the pre-existing one) raise NameError. Explains why the off-by-one did not turn the existing 60.0 test red.

[minor] always-green test — billing/test_reconcile.py:9-11: with the broken loop the sum is 50.0, and `not (abs(50-999) < 0.01)` passes, so the new test does not discriminate the regression. Locking assertion: assert reconcile_ledger_rows([Row(amount=5.0)], expected_total=5.0).
[nitpick] float money — billing/reconcile.py:6-8: float accumulation against a fixed 0.01 absolute tolerance; Decimal amounts would TypeError against 0.0. Pre-existing, not worsened.
result.summary: Adversarial (deep-review, Fable) read-only review of the synthetic review.pr-lenses replay diff. Rating: Critical 2/10. Four [major] findings: live `sk-live-` partner API key committed in billing/reconcile.py:1; `range(1, len(rows))` silently skips the first ledger row (single-row ledger reconciles to 0.0, first-row discrepancies go undetected); `partner_id` interpolated into the billing URL unencoded (path/query injection carrying the privileged bearer token); no tests for the new `fetch_partner_balance`. Four [minor]: no status check/timeout/`balance` validation; `http_client` not defined or imported in the shown module; test module never imports `Row` so the new test raises NameError (and the suite has likely never run green); the new mismatch test is green on both correct and broken loops and does not lock the regression. One [nitpick]: float accumulation with fixed 0.01 absolute tolerance on money. No files edited; no plan file created since the route is read-only report-only.
verification: Pre-verdict gate: globbed workspace for billing/reconcile.py and billing/test_reconcile.py — neither exists (synthetic replay), so http_client/Row resolution and git history audit of the range(0->1) change are not possible; those two findings are flagged unverifiable, and the off-by-one remains [major] because the unchanged existing test (sum 60.0) and the docstring document the intended semantics.
Clean areas with inputs tried: empty rows with expected_total=0.0 -> True under both loops; range(1, 0) on empty list raises no IndexError; negative amounts summed normally.
No files were edited and no external state mutated; no plan file was written because the route restricts this lane to a read-only report.
